fields.name: Material
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B09510 stores the creator's argument here; in bg3.exe+0x1B08570 that argument is an optional<uint8> returned by a virtual call (object at system+0x10, slot 1) fed with the entity's transform / level row data, 0 when empty; the update path stores a new result here. Queries pair the component with ecl::sound::CharacterSwitchDataComponent / ItemSwitchDataComponent (sound switches). Probe: 8 different values, 0x00..0x31.
